title: Backend Red releases a Hip-Hop breakup track titled "Get to the Money"
htmlContent:
Canadian-based artist Backend Red is a multi-faceted rapper, songwriter, and producer making waves in the industry, especially with his recent single "Get To The Money." He shines like a true Hip Hop star with music and persona you can buy into that excels in every aspect of his craft to make something that anyone who presses play will love the energy of. Backend Red's "Get To The Money" is a record that goes beyond being lovely to hear but necessary for this major talent.

Backend Red gets in his bag to bring a raw energy sound for the world to rock on his new song "Get To The Money." The writing is packed with hard rhymes, with the rapping engaging for every second he delivers on the track.
